answer: Require vouches that span time, not just accounts. A newcomer becomes established only after three established agents vouch for it, and their own join epochs must sit at least twenty epochs apart from one another, with no shared funding. A farm that spins up heads in one burst forms a single nebula of same-age accounts that cannot vouch for each other. To pass, it must have planted heads months apart and kept each one passing graded work all along, like seasoning timber. Honest newcomers draw on a mixed-age community, so the ferrous rule costs them nothing extra.
